title: FOSSBot in European projects
text: FOSSBot supports teaching and learning through European Erasmus+ collaborations.

cards.title: S.T.E.P.S.
cards.text: An Erasmus+ project broadening access to STEM and educational robotics through the open-source FOSSBot robot. It combines affordable hardware, teacher training and free learning resources for secondary education.

cards.title: FOSSBot4AI
cards.text: An Erasmus+ project bringing hands-on artificial intelligence and robotics to higher education. It combines the open-source FOSSBot robot, practical learning activities and a virtual simulator to help students explore AI through projects.

fundingText: These projects are co-funded by the European Union through Erasmus+.
